title: College Student Uses AI to Fabricate Face Videos and Steal Bank Cards for Over 50,000 Yuan: A Black Market Industry Comes to Light
excerpt: According to CCTV Finance, the Yuhua District People's Court of Changsha recently tried a case in which AI was used to forge facial videos to steal bank cards.
content_html:
According to CCTV Finance, the Yuhua District People's Court of Changsha recently tried a case in which AI was used to forge facial videos to steal bank cards. A college student named Wu, who was about to graduate, purchased face-swapping tools through illegal channels. Using dynamic videos generated from static photos, he bypassed the facial recognition verification of some banks, and within four months, stole more than 50,000 yuan.

From Photos to Dynamic Videos: How the Fraud Chain Was Established

The fraud gang impersonated short video customer service representatives or game streamers, luring victims to download remote control software with the bait of canceling automatic charges or gifting game items, thereby obtaining sensitive information such as ID cards, phone numbers, facial photos, and SMS verification codes. This information was then passed on to Wu, who used AI tools to generate corresponding dynamic facial videos and reset payment passwords using the verification codes.

Wu then handed over the payment code to a money laundering gang, transferring the victim's bank card funds through scanning to complete the theft. The entire case involved clear division of labor among upstream and downstream links, forming a complete closed loop from information theft, facial forgery to fund laundering, causing ordinary users to lose their account balances without even realizing it.

The Black-Gray Industry Chain Has Taken Shape, Experts Offer Tips for Prevention

Reporters found that "AI one-click face swapping" and "facial cloning" services have formed a complete black-gray industry chain online, with related tutorials and tools widely circulating through low-cost sales and hidden network disk transactions. The technical barriers have been greatly reduced, meaning similar forged fraud risks are evolving from individual cases into a widespread threat that needs attention.

Industry experts stated that the public should not be overly alarmed. Currently, financial platforms generally use multiple verification mechanisms, including facial recognition, SMS verification, and identity information checks. As long as people do not hand over their phone operation permissions to strangers or casually download unfamiliar remote control software, they can effectively avoid the risk of AI facial forgery fraud.

content_html_zh:
据央视财经报道，长沙市雨花区人民法院近日审理了一起利用人工智能伪造面部视频盗取银行卡的案件。 即将毕业的大学生吴某通过非法渠道购买了换脸工具。 他利用静态照片生成动态视频，绕过部分银行的人脸识别验证，在4个月内盗走5万余元。

从照片到动态视频：欺诈链是如何建立的

该诈骗团伙冒充短视频客服或游戏主播，以取消自动充值、赠送游戏道具等为诱饵，引诱受害人下载远程控制软件，从而获取身份证、电话号码、面部照片、短信验证码等敏感信息。 这些信息随后被传递给吴某，吴某利用人工智能工具生成相应的动态面部视频，并使用验证码重置支付密码。

吴某随后将支付码交给洗钱团伙，通过扫描转移受害人银行卡资金，完成盗窃行为。 整个案件上下游环节分工明确，形成了从信息窃取、人脸伪造到洗钱的完整闭环，导致普通用户在不知不觉中损失了账户余额。

黑灰色产业链已初具规模 专家支招防范

记者发现，“AI一键换脸”、“面部克隆”服务已经在网上形成了完整的黑灰色产业链，相关教程和工具通过低价销售和隐藏网盘交易广泛流传。 技术壁垒已大大降低，意味着类似的伪造欺诈风险正在从个别案例演变为需要关注的广泛威胁。

业内专家表示，公众不必过度惊慌。 目前，金融平台普遍采用多种验证机制，包括人脸识别、短信验证、身份信息核对等。 人们只要不将手机操作权限交给陌生人或者随意下载不熟悉的远程控制软件，就可以有效避免AI人脸伪造诈骗的风险。
